name: animated-list
title: Animated list
description: Add, remove, and rearrange without losing your place.
docs: Import { AnimatedList } from your configured components alias under bera/animated-list. Keep its companion CSS. Supply items with unique stable IDs and React content. The host owns insertion, removal, sorting, and focus after its own commands. Keep business actions in the host; this recipe supplies list semantics and motion. Exiting rows leave the focus order immediately. Replay never changes host data or repeats actions. Defaults: preview=false, speed=1, radius=12. Tested with React 19 and shadcn 4.21.0; use complete CSS color tokens. Integration: https://bera-ui.vercel.app/transitions/animated-list.agent.md
